## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      5 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 14, 2026 - Sep 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Janice McKenzie_, Sep 22, 2026, 1/5: "Purchased a 24 week plan in August 2026. Been charge for this, plus two other charges for August ($13.60, $13.53 and $42.00), and an additional 2 charges in September 2026 ($79.99 and $40.99). On Sept 21, 2026, I have requested a refund for all but the 24 week plan which I fully intended to purchase. Let's see how reputable Lasta is. If you purchase, there is an automatic renewal at a high price. Don't fall for the scam lower cost initial purchase. Stay on top of your subscription."
            2. _Anthony Smith_, Sep 16, 2026, 1/5: "I haven't used the app in some time. As a matter of fact I uninstalled the app due to me finding another app. Unfortunately the app didn't give me the option to cancel my subscription and I'm still getting charged for something I don't have so, my ratings are changing and my subscription needs to be canceled immediately"
            3. _Callie Sanchez_, Sep 20, 2026, 2/5: "pretty pushy on the payment .. I explained to the supporters. To cancel my membership, they didn't want me too and also charged my card early I told the person, I had knee replacement surgery and I won't be able to do all those steps like it is in the calendar. I would just fall behind. I was trying to cancel and get my membership fee back. They didn't want to give me a full refund I was negotiating my own money back, from 25% refund to 50% refund. my bank took care of it."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 13, 2026 - Sep 21, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _SUSAN MCNEIL_, Sep 21, 2026, 1/5: "I signed up and paid for a 28-day plan. I was careful to make sure that I only signed up for the 28 day because I have spine issues. much to my surprise, after the 28 days was up, they just charged my card for a premium membership that I never signed up for and never agreed to pay for. they're telling me they can't give me a refund back. classic bait and switch. buyer beware. I will get my money back."
            2. _Mel_, Jun 13, 2026, 1/5: "Full application bug. Attempt to withdraw a second amount without my authorization of more than 60 euros. beware. but the worst is only 2 months later. he still tries to steal amounts between 50 and 60 euros from you. No expiry date, I blocked the card. to flee"
            3. _Wanda Fay_, Sep 14, 2026, 4/5: "How do I get the Print out sheet for Tai Chi Chair Yoga? Can't find it in the Lasta App? Did My first workout and I have to say it was a lot more difficult than I thought it would be. I have Balance issues so it makes it more difficult for me."
<!--/ir-theme-->
